mechanism: When BTC perpetual funding is in an extreme positive/negative tail and aggregate open interest has simultaneously expanded unusually fast, leveraged positioning is crowded. The primary hypothesis is a 24h contrarian price unwind: short after extreme positive funding + high OI expansion, long after extreme negative funding + high OI expansion.

anti_duplication.materially_new: Primary features are raw funding-rate tail state plus aggregate open-interest expansion. No top-trader/global long-short ratio enters the signal.

source.full_coverage_rule: at least 46 common months and at least 11 common months in every calendar year
source.limited_coverage_rule: at least 36 common months and at least 8 common months in every calendar year

decision_clock.metric_alignment: Latest aggregate-open-interest observation at or before funding calc_time, maximum staleness 15 minutes.
decision_clock.oi_reference: Latest aggregate-open-interest observation at or before calc_time minus 24h, maximum staleness 15 minutes.
decision_clock.entry_price: BTCUSDT futures 1h bar OPEN at the funding event hour.
decision_clock.exit_price: BTCUSDT futures 1h bar OPEN exactly 24h later.

features.trailing_rule: All rolling thresholds are shifted by one event; the current event never contributes to its own threshold.

signal.short: funding_rate >= trailing 95th percentile AND oi_growth_24h >= trailing 80th percentile
signal.long: funding_rate <= trailing 5th percentile AND oi_growth_24h >= trailing 80th percentile
signal.overlap_rule: one active 24h position at a time; signals before the active position exits are ignored

pnl.rationale: This MVE tests forced-price-unwind, not funding carry; excluding funding cashflows avoids settlement-timing ambiguity.

statistics.bootstrap: 10000 circular moving-block resamples of primary net10 returns

no_rescue: Do not change 95/5 funding tails after outcomes.
Do not change 80th percentile OI-growth threshold after outcomes.
Do not change the 540/270 trailing history after outcomes.
Do not change 24h horizon after outcomes.
Do not add top/global trader ratios after outcomes.
Do not invert the contrarian direction after outcomes.
Do not reduce the 10 bps primary cost after outcomes.
Do not open 2025/2026 to rescue the result.
